sections.name: pool
sections.title: Printing the report and closing connections
sections.what: Either queues runs or reads freshness, prints the table, adds a note if runs were queued, and closes the pool and database client.
sections.why: Closing connections keeps the script from hanging.
sections.watch_out: The database client is closed in the final step, so nothing else can use it after this.

summary: Reports how up to date the Reality Scan, Lessons Learnt and Opportunity Map tools are compared with the research batches loaded, and can queue refresh runs for stale ones.
purpose: Lets the owner see which tools are behind after new research is loaded, and start catch-up runs.
why: The header describes it as a post-merge step, so it runs after batches load.
how: Reads the freshness of each tool per industry. With --start it queues refresh runs and optionally requeues failed runs newer than the data. It prints a plain-language table and does not wait for runs to finish.
inputs: The database through the DATABASE_URL setting and the db module, plus optional --industry, --start and --resume-failed flags.
outputs: A printed freshness table, and queued run records in the database when --start is used.
risks: --start creates real runs that use the AI usage allowance. --resume-failed re-runs failed work.
debug: Run with no flags to see states. If runs stay queued, check that the API server is running, since it starts them.
